page: Google Cloud Platform n4d-highmem-96 is an x86_64 architecture server powered by a dedicated AMD EPYC 9B45 processor. It features 96 vCPUs across 48 physical cores with multithreading enabled, paired with 768 GB of system memory. This configuration yields a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8 GB per core. The processor includes 48 KB L1d, 1.0 MB L2, and 32 MB L3 cache, alongside support for advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512, vector neural network instructions, and cryptography standards like AES and SHA_NI.

Benchmark results place this server in the top tier for both single-core and multi-core CPU performance. It demonstrates high memory bandwidth, reaching 9232.0 GB/sec for cached small-block reads and maintaining top-tier throughput in Redis SET operations at 152.44 million operations per second. Multi-threaded decompression and static web serving throughput also rank in the top 10% of tested systems. For machine learning workloads, the CPU architecture delivers strong performance in LLM inference, processing 5028.8 tokens per second for small model prompts.

This server does not include local NVMe storage or dedicated GPU hardware, meaning all storage must be network-attached, and parallel graphics acceleration is unavailable. Given its high memory density and strong multi-core processing capabilities, the server is optimized for memory-intensive workloads, large-scale database operations, software compilation, and CPU-based inference tasks.
